ResearchProjectDef.label: modular turrets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock replaceable turret bases, the assembly bench, basic main heads and support modules. The initial platform is intended for vanilla-scale defenses.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced turret engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock dual heads, miniguns, shell-fed mortars, missile launchers, shield modules, tracking servos and precision fire controllers. Also unlock tier I-III upgrades for installed heads and modules.

ResearchProjectDef.label: exotic energy turrets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock laser, Tesla and quantum heads, and tier IV-V upgrades for installed heads and modules. Quantum fire retains aiming and burst timing but applies immediate single-target damage without projectile travel or area damage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: infinite turret engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock repeatable damage, protection and range improvements for the turret base. The late-game comparison point is roughly 1,000 total base upgrades, not the initial build.
